# Getting help

- **Questions and ideas:** open an issue with the `question` label.
- **Bugs:** use the bug report template; include `scadenza version` and remove secrets from output.
- **Security problems:** never in a public issue. Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/HarnageaGabriel/scadenza/security/advisories/new); see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md).
- **Docs:** start from the [README](../README.md) and `docs/`.

scadenza is maintained in spare time, so replies can take a few days.
